messages:
Jamal: Hey team — I have a mandatory 2-week military training in late Dec that overlaps the year-end shutdown. Can someone confirm how that affects PTO carryover and blackout rules?
Maria - People Ops: Thanks for flagging, Jamal. Do you have the official orders or enrollment notice? We need that to process an exemption. :pray:
Jamal: Yes — attached to the HR portal but I can paste dates: 2026-12-21 to 2027-01-04. Orders say training is mandatory.
Alex (Eng Manager): FYI I support approving coverage. We can swap a reporter for your on-call week and move sprint touchpoints. :+1:
Maria - People Ops: Great. For military service, policy allows a blackout exemption if you provide documentation. The process: submit the orders to people-ops@redwood.ai and request a "blackout exemption". People Ops will mark the days as protected and they won't count against carryover.
Maria - People Ops: Relevant snippet from policy: `If an employee is required to perform military service or mandatory civ. training during a company shutdown, People Ops will exempt those dates from PTO carryover and accrual blackout restrictions upon receipt of official documentation.`
Jamal: Cool — should I still book PTO for the days I won't be on call, or leave them unbooked while you process?
Maria - People Ops: Leave them unbooked and submit the docs. We'll retroactively mark the days and, if needed, adjust your PTO balance so you don't lose accruals. If you prefer certainty, you can tentatively request unpaid leave in AbsencePortal and mark the reason as "military training".
Lisa: Also note: if you want to keep some paid time around the training (e.g., travel days) we can approve those as PTO outside the blackout if requested now. I can sign off once People Ops confirms.
Jamal: Thanks — submitted orders to people-ops@redwood.ai just now. Subject: "Blackout exemption request - Jamal - military training"
people-ops-bot: Request received. Ticket #PO-5421 created. Please allow 1-3 business days for review. Attachments: orders.pdf
Maria - People Ops: Got it, Jamal. I'll review and loop in payroll if we need balance adjustments. Expect an email update by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (Eng Manager): Thanks — let me know if you need me to approve anything in the system.
Jamal: Appreciate it, thanks everyone :heart:
